Her name is Claria Labreezle.|[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
'''Claria Labreezle''' was a young girl that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] encountered and ultimately rescued while on a [[Mission to Metellos|mission]] to apprehend [[Dreed Pommel]] on [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]].

Claria Labreezle lived with her parents and two siblings in a spacious suite in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ektra]] on [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]], but her happy childhood was cut short with the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of her family at the hands of criminal [[Dreed Pommel]], who then proceeded to take her hostage in an attempt to escape [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], who had been tracing Pommel for some time. As Claria was slowly being dragged back towards Pommel's [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and to certain doom, only the skillful intervention of a blast of [[Electric Judgment]] from Koon managed to enable her escape. After this, she was placed in the care of relatives at [[Stratablock 7]] on [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]].
